quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?

options.text: Do not enter.
One-way.
Stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An octagon (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop sign ahead.
Side road.
Railroad warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: You are driving defensively when you:

options.text: Keep one car length between you and the car ahead.
Look only at the car in front of you.
Keep your eyes moving to spot possible dangers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your eyes moving to spot possible dangers.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means looking ahead for potential hazards. Staring only at the road directly in front of you is dangerous. Scan the road ahead and stay alert to vehicles around you.

questions.question: At an intersection with a "Yield" sign, you must:

options.text: Give the right-of-way to traffic that is close enough to cause a crash.
Give the right-of-way only to vehicles on your right.
Always slow down and continue without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic that is close enough to cause a crash.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down or stop if needed. Give the right-of-way to any crossing or merging traffic that is close enough to cause a crash.

questions.question: If your vehicle is about to be hit from behind, you should NOT:

options.text: Apply your brakes.
Let go of the steering wheel.
Press your head firmly against the head restraint.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let go of the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If hit from behind, your body will be thrown backward. Press yourself against the back of your seat and press your head against the head restraint. Hold the steering wheel firmly and be ready to brake to avoid hitting another vehicle.

questions.question: If you want to enter the freeway but there is no gap in traffic, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and force other drivers to make room.
Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap.
Stop at the end of the ramp to wait for a gap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap.
questions.explanation: If there is no space to enter the freeway, slow down on the ramp. Do not stop at the end of the ramp because you will not have enough room to speed up before joining traffic.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red light at an intersection, you must:

options.text: Stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go.
Slow down and continue with caution.
Stop and stay stopped as long as the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When you approach an intersection with a flashing red signal, you must:

options.text: Stop completely, check for traffic or pedestrians, then proceed.
Slow down and continue with caution.
Stop and stay stopped as long as the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, check for traffic or pedestrians, then proceed.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red signal like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and go when safe.

questions.question: In bad weather, you should:

options.text: Turn off the road.
Drive in a low gear.
Steer and brake smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer and brake smoothly.
questions.explanation: In bad weather, avoid sudden braking and sharp turns. These actions make your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; the road curves ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: You are driving behind a motorcycle and want to pass. You must:

options.text: Stay in the right lane because the motorcycle is small and does not use all of the lane.
Blow your horn to make the motorcycle move to the shoulder so you can pass.
Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before you pass and stay there while passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before you pass and stay there while passing.
questions.explanation: When passing a motorcycle, give it a full lane. Never share the same lane as a motorcycle. If you return to the original lane too soon, the rider may have to swerve right into traffic or off the road.

questions.question: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, you must:

options.text: Stop, no matter which direction you are traveling.
Stop only if you are traveling in the same direction.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, no matter which direction you are traveling.
questions.explanation: When you see a school bus picking up or dropping off children, you must stop completely before you reach the bus. This applies no matter which direction you are traveling.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, you should:

options.text: Brake lightly.
Do not use the brakes.
Brake hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not use the brakes.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle starts to skid, do not use the brakes. Using the brakes will make the skid worse.

questions.question: When should you give up your legal right-of-way?

options.text: Often, even at controlled intersections.
Whenever it helps prevent a crash.
Never. It confuses other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Whenever it helps prevent a crash.
questions.explanation: Do not assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way. Give up your right-of-way whenever it helps prevent a crash.

questions.question: If you have a green light but traffic blocks the intersection ahead, you should:

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Wait outside the intersection until traffic clears.
Follow other vehicles and enter the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait outside the intersection until traffic clears.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, do not enter the intersection if other vehicles are blocking your path. If you get stuck in the intersection when the light turns red, you will block cross traffic. You can get a ticket for blocking an intersection.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. You must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Pedestrian crossing ahead.
Pedestrians cannot cross here.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. If a pedestrian is in a crosswalk at this location, you must stop and stay stopped until they are no longer in the crosswalk.

questions.question: You are approaching a yellow traffic light and have not entered the intersection yet. You should:

options.text: Speed up to pass through before the red light.
Slow down and carefully go through the intersection.
Stop safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop safely.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means prepare to stop. If you have not entered the intersection, come to a safe stop. If you are already in the intersection, clear it quickly.

questions.question: When entering a freeway, check traffic by:

options.text: Using your rearview and side mirrors.
Using your rearview mirror.
Using your side mirror and looking over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using your side mirror and looking over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Before entering a freeway, you must know what traffic is doing. Use your side mirror and look over your shoulder to see traffic clearly when you enter.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Only go when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, where should you turn?

options.text: Into any lane.
Into the first lane.
Into the second lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Into the first lane.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the first available legal lane. When turning from a two-way street to a one-way street, turn into the first lane.

questions.question: When are streets and highways most slippery?

options.text: When it has been raining hard for several hours.
When they are clean and dry.
Just after it starts to rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: Just after it starts to rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery at the start of rain. Water mixes with oil and dirt on the road before they wash away. Be extra careful when rain first begins.

questions.question: When stopped at double railroad tracks, when may you proceed?

options.text: When there are no trains approaching on either track.
As soon as one train has passed.
Only when the train is out of sight.

questions.correctAnswerText: When there are no trains approaching on either track.
questions.explanation: At railroad crossings with multiple tracks, wait until the passing train is far down the track. A second train may be hidden behind the first train. Always check both tracks before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
No U-turns.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No turning.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Stop sign ahead.
Divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that turns in the direction of the arrow are not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Yield to all traffic before crossing.
Stop, then enter when it is safe.
Slow down and cross carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down to a safe speed and proceed with caution. Watch for other traffic.

questions.question: Your license can be suspended if you are under 21 and drive with a blood alcohol level of:

options.text: 0.15 percent or more.
0.08 percent or more.
Any amount.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any amount.
questions.explanation: There is zero tolerance for alcohol in drivers under 21. Any trace of alcohol will result in serious penalties, including a two-year license suspension.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road narrows ahead.
There are curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to dangerous road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a winding road with curves coming up.

questions.question: If a child is about to run into the street, what should you do?

options.text: Prepare to slow down.
Flash your headlights.
Sound a sharp blast of your horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sound a sharp blast of your horn.
questions.explanation: Use a sharp horn blast when a child or pedestrian is about to enter the street in front of your vehicle. This gives them a warning.
